description: Delete one tag, and the image it points to, from this organization's Edgegap container registry, to clean up old builds. Takes exactly one image name and one exact tag; wildcards, lists and "latest" are refused, and there is no bulk delete. A version that still uses the tag can no longer start deployments, so check edgegap_list_app_versions first. Cannot be undone.

dry_run.description: Show the exact request (method, host, path, body) with secrets masked, and send nothing. Local checks still run. Use it to confirm a billable or destructive call before making it.

image_name.description: The image name only, e.g. "my-game-server", as for edgegap_list_registry_tags.

tag.description: The exact tag to delete, e.g. "build-41".

name: edgegap_delete_registry_tag
title: Delete one image tag from the Edgegap registry
